what: After the analyst removes a trial from the watchlist they opened it from, using Remove from this list on the trial page, switching to the trial's own Trial details or History tab forgets that watchlist. "Back to" then names the trial's first watchlist instead (in the reproduction, "Back to Myeloma" where it read "Back to Elsewhere" a moment before), the address is rewritten to name that other watchlist, the Undo for the removal disappears, and on returning to Changes, Next trial walks the other watchlist's Needs review queue. The spec says the address keeps naming the watchlist after a removal and that only a later reload falls back (user stories 15 and 22). The cause is that each of the trial's tabs is drawn afresh from the server, which no longer lists the watchlist, so the page applies the stale-address fallback and rewrites the address on a tab switch as well as on a reload.
